project_title: Silent Architecture & Cartography - World Class Redesign
tone: Quiet, editorial, highly disciplined ('we build in silence'), true-north compass metaphor

headings.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tight leading-[1.05] italic

layout_and_grids.bento_grid_rules: Asymmetric multi-span cards with 1px border (#232325), rounded-sm (max 4px radius), internal padding p-6 sm:p-10
layout_and_grids.mobile_first: Strict single column on <648px scaling seamlessly to multi-column desktop layouts. Images capped at max-h-[75vh] on mobile

hero_compass.description: An interactive, multi-layered 3D/SVG gyroscopic 4-point compass star centered in the hero section.
hero_compass.visual_details: Features concentric rotating brass rings (#b8945f), lat/long tick marks, subtle mouse parallax tilt, glowing cardinal axes (N/E/S/W), and active node pulses for Direction, Validation, Blueprint, Growth, and Legacy.
hero_compass.interactions: Hovering or clicking node buttons highlights specific vector ray lines projecting out from the compass hub to the section edges.
hero_compass.mobile_adaptation: Scales fluidly to fit within 340px width while preserving touch-drag rotation and node selection.

topographic_background_canvas.description: Dual-layer canvas blending a subtle starfield with interactive topographic contour lines.
topographic_background_canvas.visual_details: Ultra-low opacity line vectors simulating terrain heightmaps that softly distort around the user's cursor.
topographic_background_canvas.performance: Hardware accelerated HTML5 canvas with throttled requestAnimationFrame rendering.

magnetic_cursor.visual_details: Inner solid brass dot (4px) + outer lagging 1px ring (36px). Scales and displays current lat/long coordinates or action text ('EXPLORE', 'VIEW', 'SELECT') when hovering over interactive elements.

site_loader.description: Editorial preloader with silent monolith transition.
site_loader.visual_details: Centered brass 4-point star expanding outward with a digital percentage counter (00 -> 100%) in Cormorant Garamond italic.

kinetic_marquee.visual_details: 1px top and bottom brass borders (#232325), uppercase monospace text with repeating diamond compass glyphs moving with smooth momentum.

services_blueprint_cards.visual_details: 1px solid line dividers, numerical indicators (01 - 05) in brass, hover state triggers a faint brass beam overlay and directional arrow reveal.

process_journey_flow.visual_details: Vertical dashed brass vector line connecting steps with glowing waypoint nodes, coordinate timestamps, and accompanying dark luxury imagery.

insights_editorial_grid.description: Magazine-style asymmetric bento layout for articles.
insights_editorial_grid.visual_details: Feature card with dark architectural imagery overlay, sub-cards with hover elevation and brass tag badges.

motion_and_animation.scroll_behavior: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling with dampening 0.1
motion_and_animation.transitions: Specific property transitions (e.g. opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)). NO universal 'transition: all'
motion_and_animation.accessibility: Full respects for prefers-reduced-motion using Framer Motion's useReducedMotion hook

testing_and_accessibility.test_id_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, nav links, forms, inputs, FAQ triggers, service links, and insights cards MUST retain or include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-link-about', data-testid='contact-submit-btn')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_wcag: Text contrast maintained above 4.5:1 ratio against #0a0a0b and #101011 using #f2eee4 and #8b8880
testing_and_accessibility.focus_states: Focus visible rings in brass tint outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#b8945f]

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain ALL existing content, routes, textual copy, and data structures verbatim.
Elevate the visual experience to world-class Awwwards standard using strict architectural luxury aesthetics.
Ensure header navigation has backdrop blur with non-transparent dark background (#0a0a0b/80).
Implement the 4-point compass hero graphic with SVG layers and framer-motion interactive state switches.
All components should strictly use .jsx / .js format.
Ensure mobile drawer, contact form modal/section, FAQ accordion, and page transitions work smoothly.
